question: How does the power of will give rise to the state of the letter ya?
premises: The power of will exists in two modes, stirred and unstirred.
It turns toward a portion of a different power.
Through that orientation it becomes the state of ya.
inference: The letter ya arises when will-power, in its stirred or unstirred mode, inclines toward another power.
plain_english: And the power of will, which is twofold as stirred and unstirred, turns toward a portion of a different power and goes to the state of ya.
